figures.caption: Table 1: Accuracy of single-ad insertion across varying strategies and model scales. We evaluate the selection accuracy of Embed Models and Gen Models on three distinct simulated scenarios: Complex Intent Analysis, Natural Intent Shift, and Negative Product Refinement. LERA consistently outperforms the embedding-only baseline.

Figure 1: Comparison of ad selection strategies for LLM-based chatbots. Each panel shows a different approach: Embedding-only uses only embedding similarity weighted by bids; LLM-Only scores all advertisers using LLM logits combined with bids; LERA first filters candidates with embedding similarity and then applies LLM-logit scoring on the top-K set. Payment annotations indicate the auction mechanism used in each method, and the bars illustrate relative selection accuracy and system throughput.
